## What it is

Overview of the external services Digital Sales Rooms depends on, with links to their setup guides:

- **Daily.co** — realtime video call: [realtime video call setup](platform/dev/6.7/products/digital-sales-rooms/setup-3rd-party/realtime-video-dailyco.md)
- **Mercure** — realtime service: [Mercure setup](platform/dev/6.7/products/digital-sales-rooms/setup-3rd-party/realtime-service-mercure.md)

## When to use

After installing the plugin and the frontend app, when you configure the video and realtime services Digital Sales Rooms needs.

## Code check (6.7.13.0)
- unverified `Daily.co` — external SaaS used by the licensed DSR plugin; no reference in vendor/shopware
- unverified `Mercure` — external hub used by the licensed DSR plugin; no reference in vendor/shopware
